notes.title: 1.05 - New Achievements
notes.notes:
Greetings, sweepers!

This is the first update since launch and adds more achievements to the game. 
You'll now earn a new achievement for each 5 arcade levels completed.
There are also some small UI changes and localization bug-fixes.

It's only been 3 days since releasing the game, so please let me know about any bugs or problems you experience.
